messages:
carmen-devex: quick check — we're seeing a weird case with long-lived streaming clients + service account OIDC tokens. If a streaming connection is opened under project A (sa impersonation/aud=projA) and then client starts sending requests for project B, should the SDK try to refresh/reauth mid-stream or fail-fast? :thinking:

sanjay-ml: what triggers it? 401 from server with aud mismatch? or token exp? any logs?

carmen-devex: we saw 401 with a message like "audience mismatch" after a few hours. client kept retrying frames but server immediately closed once we started using project-B routes.

morgan-sdk: current Node SDK refresh flow: on 401 we do a token refresh then retry the request. For streaming we only refresh on token_expiry pre-emptively, not on aud mismatch. so aud mismatch ends up as repeated 401s and eventual stream close.

kevin-eng: yeah that's the bug — aud is part of the JWT, if you impersonate different target services you need to re-run the OIDC exchange with new audience. The SDK shouldn't silently reuse the old SA token for a different project route.

morgan-sdk: proposed behavior: if server returns 401 with "audience" or "aud" in body, for streaming we should attempt a token exchange with the new aud and if successful resume the stream (with backoff). if exchange fails, surface an error and close.

carmen-devex: sounds reasonable. any security concerns with auto-reauth mid-stream? we don't want to accidentally cross scopes/org boundaries.

sanjay-ml: we should only auto-reauth if the client config allows "allowScopeSwitch": true (off by default). for customers using multi-tenant creds they must opt in. otherwise fail-fast and log the mismatch.

morgan-sdk: agree. default off, explicit flag required. implement as: on aud-mismatch 401 => emit event "reauth-required" with suggested aud; if config.allowScopeSwitch then perform exchange and append new auth header and continue, else close.

kevin-eng: also make sure we rotate kv cache / per-connection caches when aud changes, otherwise stale cache could leak tokens across projects.

morgan-sdk: good call — will clear connection-level caches on aud change.

carmen-devex: quick snippet for how we detect aud-mismatch from server (from logs):
```
{"error":"invalid_token","error_description":"audience mismatch: expected \"https://inference.redwood.com/projA\" got \"https://inference.redwood.com/projB\""}
```

morgan-sdk: I'll open a tiny PR to add the flag + event and a test that simulates server 401 with aud mismatch. pinging @kevin-eng for infra test harness.

kevin-eng: 👍 will add a test route that returns aud mismatch 401 after N frames.

deploy-bot: deploy pipeline queued for morgan-sdk/reauth-aud-flag (CI will run unit + integration tests)

infra-bot: noted: ticket INF-4923 created to track connection cache clearing and audits.

carmen-devex: perfect — closing this thread for now. will watch PR.
